title: Transcendence degree in an injective tower of domains
statement: Let $A\subseteq B\subseteq C$ be inclusions of commutative domains (nonzero commutative rings without zero divisors), with the $A$-algebra structure on $C$ the composite of the two inclusions. For the algebra transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree], one has $\operatorname{trdeg}_A C=\operatorname{trdeg}_A B+\operatorname{trdeg}_B C$, with cardinal addition and cardinal lifts when the universes differ.
